Agreement and operator

1on1 is provided by Moran Ohana, operating as Ohana Labs, in Israel. Contact: ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com. These Terms cover the app and its local two-player and computer-opponent games.

Choose the Terms agreement only if you are legally able to agree, or are a parent or guardian approving use for a child. If you do not agree, do not continue to gameplay; you can still read all documents. A Privacy Policy acknowledgment is not consent to tracking or a substitute for any separate consent required by law.

The collection and local play

The current collection contains 28 illustrated board, card, memory and reaction games. Two people can share one device, or one person can play against a local computer opponent. There are no player accounts, online opponents, chat, cloud saves, purchases or paid game currency.

Games work without an internet connection. Scores, named sessions and settings are stored on the device. Scores and virtual pieces have no monetary value and cannot be redeemed. Rules, availability and computer difficulty may change in updates.

Advertising

The current development build can request Google test advertisements on Android and iOS after the local legal notice step. Live advertising is disabled in the prepared release configuration. Test ads and privacy/preload requests can still involve Google processing technical information; see the Privacy Policy.

The configured placement is between completed rounds: at least three completed rounds and five foreground minutes, with no ad in the first five foreground minutes. An unavailable ad is skipped and does not prevent play. No ad is placed during a round, at launch or on exit. Native ad content may have its own close, mute and external-link controls.

Before live ads are enabled, the documents and store disclosures must be updated as needed and any required permissions obtained. Advertising is not an endorsement by Ohana Labs. A parent or guardian may report unsuitable ads to ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com without sending a child's identifying details.

Children and comfortable play

The app is designed for families, including children around age five and older playing with appropriate guidance. A store content rating is not a statement that a child can enter a legal agreement or give advertising consent. A parent or guardian should review the documents, settings and any external ad content.

Games contain movement, colored effects, optional sound and vibration. Take breaks and stop if uncomfortable. Do not play while driving or when your attention is needed for safety. Sound and vibration can be turned off in Settings.

Local data and availability

Settings, saved session scores, opening order and the local legal receipt can be lost through clearing app storage, deleting the app, device failure or some updates. A session restores scores, not an unfinished board. We cannot remotely recover or synchronize your local data. Device backups are controlled by your operating system, not by us.

We aim to maintain a working app, but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, compatibility with every device or preservation of every save. Nothing here removes mandatory consumer rights.
